about: The vocabulary for each scene's world and kind in manifest.json, and the tags for the scenes bundled with the app, which are not in the manifest. A world is the time and culture a book lives in; a kind is what the reader sees. catalog-map.py turns these into CATALOG-MAP.md, and CatalogManifestContentTest requires every published scene to use them.

nature.name: Nature, any book
nature.summary: Landscapes, weather and sea that fit any era.

modern-any.name: Modern, any city
modern-any.summary: Kitchens, offices, hospitals, cafés and gyms: the same in Osaka or Ohio.

modern-east-asia.name: Modern East Asia
modern-east-asia.summary: Japan, China, Korea, Hong Kong and Taiwan since about 1950.

modern-west.name: Modern West
modern-west.summary: Places that are distinctly American or European today: Manhattan, Brooklyn, Paris, roadside America.

imperial-china.name: Imperial China
imperial-china.summary: Dynastic China, including the worlds of wuxia and xianxia.

old-japan.name: Old Japan
old-japan.summary: Japan before about 1870: Edo streets, castles, samurai houses and temples.

classical.name: Classical Mediterranean
classical.summary: Bronze-Age Greece to imperial Rome: the Odyssey, the forum and the arena.

industrial.name: Industrial age
industrial.summary: About 1800 to 1945, mostly European: stations, mills, docks, ballrooms and country houses.

wider-world.name: Wider world
wider-world.summary: South Asia, the Middle East, Africa and Latin America, past and present.

imagined.name: Imagined
imagined.summary: Fantasy and science fiction: places that never existed.

home.name: Home
home.summary: Where people live: rooms, apartments, houses and huts.

street.name: Street
street.summary: Streets, lanes, squares, rooftops and city views.

food.name: Eat and drink
food.summary: Restaurants, bars, cafés, teahouses and taverns.

power.name: Power
power.summary: Throne rooms, courts, police stations, prisons and palaces.

work.name: Work and learning
work.summary: Offices, schools, libraries, laboratories, workshops and mills.

travel.name: Travel
travel.summary: Ships, trains, planes, stations and roads.

land.name: Landscape and sea
land.summary: Open country, wild places and water.
